newsitem.title: USA: Criticare sees redesign boosting Q4.
newsitem.headline: Criticare sees redesign boosting Q4.

text.p: Criticare Systems Inc said Friday it expects to reap benefits from a three-year product redesign process in the fourth quarter of fiscal year 1997, ending in June.
"The fourth quarter will be our first opportunity to profit from over three years of corporate product redesign," chief executive officer Gerhard Von der Ruhr said.

The patient monitoring systems company said its order backlog was on the rise; it was making international progress as evidenced by a $400,000 order from China; its remote monitoring product was being shipped to important teaching hospitals; and new products from a collaberation should make a revenue contribution.
The company earlier Friday reported a net loss of $284,678, or $0.04 a share, for the third quarter ended March 31, compared to a loss of $217,682, or $0.03 a share, ayear ago.
